body: Fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes handed to mitosis on 2026-09-27.U+000AU+000ASetup:U+000AU+002D The local feat/composer-editor-core was fast-forwarded from 4031189 to d36b748. The owner's uncommitted tool/probe/macos/drive.sh is untouched.U+000AU+002D Run folder ~/.mitosis/field-notes/e2e-fixes holds CHARTER.md, accept.zsh, dispatch.zsh, worker-rules.txt, pr_adapter.py (PRs via pr.mjs pr-create, then marked draft), waves.py, wave1/2/3.items.json and wave1.log.U+000AU+000AThe first plan fused 32 of 35 Steps into one PR, because the area groups share files. The owner approved a delivery regrouping into three file-disjoint waves, merging between waves (decisions file):U+000AU+002D Wave 1: 15 Steps, 7 MSPs, 8 lanes.U+000AU+002D Wave 2: 15 Steps, 3 MSPs.U+000AU+002D Wave 3: 5 Steps, 1 MSP.U+000AU+000AThe owner also approved taking the composer spec doc edits out of the photo Steps, because docs/specs/ is git-ignored. I applied the P3, P4, P6 and E6 amendments and two replacing decision lines to the local docs/specs/composer-editor-core.md and its decisions file.U+000AU+000AThe first launch stopped at `git worktree add`: mitosis/photos is still checked out in an old run's worktree. I removed the five empty branches and worktrees the failed start had just created, and renamed two groups to avoid old branch names: photos became photo-placement, cosmetics became count-plurals. Wave 1 then relaunched, with 4 workers running (tiers: top claude-opus-5-5, cheap claude-sonnet-5; timeout 10800 s).U+000AU+000ANext: when wave 1 finishes, read the last JSON line of wave1.log and give the owner the 7 draft PRs with their gate verdicts. After the owner merges wave 1, launch wave 2 from ~/.mitosis/field-notes/e2e-fixes/wave2.items.json with the same flags, then wave 3.
